I found the explanations in `skin.conf` to be very confusing because the
terminology is not always well defined, and the effects of the options are not
always clear.

I would suggest instead of trying to describe the effects of the options in the
text file `skin.conf`, put it in the documentation. Then you can offer graphical
examples of the effects of the options.

Overall, there are too many options and too many ways of doing the same thing.
If I could give one bit of advice it would be to run this program, then follow
the wisdom:

    python -c "import this"
